names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 aprilie, «Sfântul Ierarh Calinic de la Cernica, Episcopul Râmnicului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Καλλίνικος ο εκ Ρουμανίας», with the rank word and the clause naming his country left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 11 апреля ст. ст., name page 14907, «Святитель Каллиник Черникский, епископ Рымника-Вылчи, епископ, свт.», with the rank words and the see left off. The day’s own line gives the name in the genitive. `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports the stored form as a key no other folder holds. The see the Russian title gives, «епископа Рымника-Вылчи», is Râmnicu Vâlcea, which this folder’s Romanian life already names; `office` is left as it stood, because what is read here is a Russian rendering of a Romanian see and not a new finding about it.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life: «s-a născut la 7 octombrie, 1787 în București, aproape de biserica Sfântul Visarion. Din sfântul botez a primit numele de Constantin».

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «s-a mutat la cereștile locașuri … la 11 aprilie, 1868».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 апреля ст. ст. — «Свт. Каллиника Черникского (1868) (Рум.).»
source.note: The line carries the tag «(Рум.)», Romanian, which this calendar puts against a saint it keeps from another local church’s reckoning, and the day page gives him no life page at all. The year in the line is the one this folder already carries from doxologia.ro.

feast.note: doxologia.ro listed him on its 13 aprilie page, whose movable feasts are those of 2026 — 11 April Holy Saturday, 12 April Pascha — but his own life on the same site says plainly «prăznuirea lui se face la 11 aprilie», the day of his repose in 1868, and that is the day kept here.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 aprilie — «Sfântul Ierarh Calinic de la Cernica, Episcopul Râmnicului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Καλλίνικος ο εκ Ρουμανίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(1787 - 1868)», which agrees with the years the folder already holds from doxologia; the corpus's `dates` are left as they stand. The Greek calendar therefore keeps him on 11 April as his own Romanian life does, which is the day the folder already holds — and not on the 13 aprilie that doxologia's day page put him on because of that year's moveable feasts. The day's line calls him only ο εκ Ρουμανίας, from Romania, and gives him no see; the page's prose makes him bishop of Râmnic-Vâlcea, elected 15 Σεπτεμβρίου 1850, consecrated 26 Οκτωβρίου and enthroned 26 Νοεμβρίου at Craiova because the see at Râmnic had burnt. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

hymns.text: De Dumnezeu purtătorule, părintele nostru Calinic, povăţuitorule al călugărilor, podoaba cuvioşilor şi lauda arhiereilor, ajutătorule al celor din nevoi şi făcătorule de minuni! Cu nevoinţele tale chip de sfinţenie te-ai arătat, iar acum cu îngerii în ceruri te veseleşti; cu care roagă pe Milostivul Dumnezeu să ne dăruiască nouă pace şi mare milă.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Calinic de la Cernica, Episcopul Râmnicului», Glasul 1

english.text: God-bearing father Calinic, guide of monks, adornment of the venerable and praise of bishops, helper of those in need and worker of wonders! By your labours you were shown to be an image of holiness, and now you rejoice with the angels in heaven; with them entreat the merciful God to grant us peace and great mercy.
